notes.title: [Ad Break] Introducing Outcast Tales: The First Journey
notes.content:
Greetings, dear viewers!

While the COMUNITV crew is still hard at work on recovering footage from Drowned Lake, today we got a word from our friends at Hardlane Studio who just released the free prologue chapter to their upcoming game [i]Outcast Tales[/i], titled [i]Outcast Tales: The First Journey[/i].

[previewyoutube=T2JRPrdKnPA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/882590/Outcast_Tales_The_First_Journey/

[b]Outcast Tales[/b] is a turn-based tactical rogue-like gang of (un)likeable misfits trying to brave deadly Wastelands… and each other’s opinions. Mix and match the classes AND personalities of your crewmates, explore (and plunder) the Wastelands, fight formidable enemies and write your own Tale!

[list]
[*] Outcast Tales: The First Journey is a [b]completely free to play[/b] first chapter of Outcast Tales
[*] Audio narration for the events, done by Samuel Barnett — the famous Dirk Gently  from [b]Dirk Gently’s Holistic Detective Agency[/b] and [b]Delamain[/b] from [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b]!
[*] [b]Contracts[/b]: a series of side-quests that you can complete across multiple playthroughs and unlock new gear, abilities and even new classes and personalities
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] — interact with your friends or viewers through a [b]multitude of features![/b]
[/list]

If you want to learn more about Outcast Tales or wish to chat with other wastelanders, consider following Outcast Tales on X [i](formerly known as Twitter)[/i], joining CRITICAL REFLEX Discord and wishlisting the full game on Steam to be the first to play it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551970/Outcast_Tales/


[i]This message was brought to you by the CR Channel. Join our terrifyingly good Discord community, where we're all about horrors![/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/qZVKcJQkyv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: TELEFORUM Extra Episode Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings, dear viewers!

[h3]Seeing such positive reception of TELEFORUM, we’ve decided to expand the game with a content update — coming November 30th![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/5c3e4093793d1bfa59b812ed73e6b5b9c59a74e8.png[/img]

Knowing our audiences we wouldn’t dare to spoil the extra episode’s contents, but rest assured it will be held up to the same standard as the main game.

STAY TUNED FOR FURTHER BROADCASTS.

[url=https://discord.gg/qZVKcJQkyv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160527/a76ad436b7bf7f86a2bf227d2b183c6db9a9bf59.png[/img][/url]
